latestVersion.changelog:
Sora AI Video Creator — Initial Release

- Launches a cloud-based tool to generate 1080p MP4 videos from text prompts.
- Supports uploads in MP4, MOV, WebM, GIF formats (up to 500MB); rendering output ready in 1–3 minutes.
- Provides 100 free credits with anonymous authentication via a token system.
- Offers workflows for video generation, editing, timeline preview, file export, and draft state management.
- Handles errors robustly, with clear user guidance for token issues, file limits, credits, and subscriptions.
